note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after a78870fd39). RFC 5798 Section 5.2.8 says "The checksum is the 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of the entire VRRP message starting with the version field and a "pseudo-header" as defined in Section 8.1 of [RFC2460]. The next header field in the ..." Ze now computes this form for IPv4 only in a group configured checksum rfc5798-compatible, because RFC 9568 Section 5.2.8, which obsoletes this text, says the IPv4 checksum "only includes the VRRP message"; the default IPv4 group neither sends nor accepts it, and the earlier sentence about dual-accept is withdrawn. TestFillChecksumFamilies (v3v4 under rfc5798-compatible) and TestFillChecksumZeroesFieldAndCoversPseudoHeader pin the IPv4 pseudo-header sum 0xDEFB and the IPv6 one in every mode; an overlay mutant forcing verifyReceived to the message-only form reddened the compatible-mode decodes. The only proof that a compatible group carries the mode from instance.doSendAdvert to the wire is the keepalived interop scenario, which no tag names. Enforced for the compatible mode only.
